title: Committed Draft
description:
1) Type your narrative (I recommend NOT typing it direclty into Schoology --
    type it in Microsoft Word instead!)
 2) Get your draft to a point where you've fully told the story. It doesn't
    have to be perfect yet, but make sure you've told the full story. Don't
    forget to move things around or add sections in order to fit your chosen
    structure from yesterday!
 3) Revise the end of your narrative to include an effective realization (see
    the attached slides to help with this).  - Link: http://troyschools.schoology.com/assignment/8561780164

title: 13 - Polyatomic Ions Quiz
description:
If you get more than 2 wrong, you will have a *zero *for your score, but you  
can retake it.

After you retake it once, you can keep your score, but you could keep  
retaking it to get an 8/8. •The retakes are either before school, after  
school, or during lunches.    /You can receive 2 points of extra credit, if  
you get 14 out of 16 correct /(no more than 2 wrong)/ *on the 1st try*/
 

The quiz will be on paper. - Link: http://troyschools.schoology.com/assignment/8536268257
